# The owners of an_owner_of_each_kind_with_an_address.txt, named and nothing
# else.
#
# This is what a person writes to correct a name — the block they are editing,
# not a transcript of everything the book holds — and it is what every printed
# document carries. An absent key is not an instruction: `addr[0]:` missing says
# nothing about the address, the way `notes:` missing has always said nothing
# about a transaction's notes.
#
# Read as an instruction, it blanked the address, the email, and reactivated a
# customer the book had retired, because the default behind `active:` is true.
#
# What this fixture produces: the two owners renamed, and everything the file
# does not mention left as the book had it.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_an_absent_key_is_not_an_instruction.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100

customer "C-ADDR"
	name: "Acme Supplies Limited"
	currency: CAD

vendor "V-ADDR"
	name: "Beta Printing Company"
	currency: CAD
